score_evidence.A: No body H1 and no skipped levels; math only as $$; front matter fine (description 142 chars, opens with 'Strands Agents SDK'). Deductions: there is no TL;DR, and the post opens straight into '## 에이전트 루프의 동작 원리' (L11). There are 14 H2 sections running through about 14 docs pages, so it reads as a docs walk-through. The sources block uses an English '### Sources' heading after a '- - -' rule, with '|' entities in link titles (L2650-2668). L2598 has a bare URL '(https://github.com/strands-agents/agent-sop)' instead of [title](link). The tag 'Agentic-AI' repeats the category (L6-7).
score_evidence.B: The 입니다 register holds and the Korean mostly reads naturally. Deductions: code comments drop into the 한다 register, e.g. L52 '각 결과를 요청 ID로 짝짓는다' and L54 '이력에 넣는다' (rewrite: '짝짓습니다'/'넣습니다'). Table cells use 음슴체 (L79-83, L191 '더 할 행동이 없음'). '할 수 있습니다' appears 15 times, and there are 3 '> **핵심:**' callouts (L177, L482, L788). L37 '이 구조에는 설계 철학이 담겨 있습니다' is a formulaic opener (rewrite: 'Strands가 이 구조를 고른 이유는 …입니다').
score_evidence.C: Back-references ('앞서 …') are accurate, and concepts are introduced before use. Deductions: the running example (codebase security analysis, L73-173) stops after section 1. The second half (interventions L2097, steering L2434) reads as stitched doc pages. In L2225-2233 the comment '# 거부된 도구 호출에 대해서는 실행되지 않습니다' implies a before_tool_call Deny skips an after_model_call handler, but Deny short-circuits only handlers on the same event.
score_evidence.D: Hard points get worked traces: hook order with order and reverse groups (L781-788), the limit-check overshoot (L313), the tool-count trace (L980-987) and the proactive-compression trace (L1865-1874). Deductions: easy material is padded, with Python and TypeScript twins for almost every feature, and the same 'tool error becomes an error result' point is re-explained at L69, L151, L155, L211 and L1073.
score_evidence.E: 28 tables, 75 code blocks, one ASCII loop diagram (L19-33) and two formulas. There is no real architecture figure, only ASCII. The history formula $$H_k = H_{k-1} \oplus a_k \oplus r_k$$ (L98) adds nothing. Code is heavily duplicated across Python and TypeScript, and the production handler is shown twice (L215-242 and L2610-2646).
score_evidence.F: Very high fidelity to the official docs, including API reference details (add_callback list/None/union ValueError, AttributeError on writes). One clear error: L2180 '주민번호 형식의 개인정보를 가립니다' with regex \d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4} (L2190). The source calls this ssn_pattern, the US SSN format; a Korean resident number is 6-7 digits. -2.
score_evidence.T1: Concrete snippets with real APIs, flags and defaults, in both SDKs. A few snippets leave out imports (L136, L2111, L2165).
score_evidence.T2: Coverage is grounded in official pages and the learning order is sensible. It expands far beyond the two input URLs (agent-loop, hooks) to 14 doc pages, which pads breadth.
score_evidence.T3: Internals are good: cancellation checkpoints (L362-373), limit-check timing (L309-317), callback-order semantics (L781-790), middleware vs hooks (L1490-1502). Deductions: only 1 of 16 sources is non-official (AWS ML blog, L2666). There is no 'when to choose Strands vs alternatives'. Observability gets little: only the trace-span note at L1502, and no metrics or AgentResult.metrics.
